spans.s: haḍa = (and prob. error for) haḍi, q.v.: haḍa-nigaḍabandhanair Kv 〔31.7〕.

haḍi (Skt. Lex. once, said to be m., BR; AMg. id., said to be f., Ratnach.), fetter made of wood; so Tib., confirmed by SP, below; always associated with, usually immediately followed by, nigaḍa, iron shackles: haḍinigaḍa LV 〔337.9〕 (vs) = Tib. śiṅ sgrog daṅ ni lcags sgrog, wooden fetters and iron fetters; dārvāyasmayair (so text, see this) haḍi-nigaḍa-bandhanair SP 〔440.4〕 (prose); dārumayair ayomayair haḍi-nigaḍair iha baddha bandhanaiḥ SP 〔450.1〕 (vs); haḍi-nigaḍa- Mv 〔i.18.1〕 (so mss., Senart wrongly em. hasti-ni˚); Divy 〔250.29〕; 〔365.4〕; 〔435.17〕; Gv 〔353.11〕 (see s.v. kaṭaka); haḍi-daṇḍa-bandhanigaḍāś Gv 〔213.24〕 (vs). Cf. prec.
